items.title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI launches in ChatGPT
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 with an 'Intelligent UI' that lets ChatGPT reply with visuals and interactive tools. Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users get GPT-6 Sol, while Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna.
items.notes: Page could not be fetched directly (openai.com unreachable from the sandbox); details and date come from a search-result digest of the official page. Verify before publishing.

items.title: OpenAI shares new mathematical results from an internal frontier model
items.summary_en: OpenAI published a broad set of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model. It also committed $5 million to a Simons Foundation initiative supporting mathematicians.
items.notes: Posted Oct 6 and reportedly updated Oct 15 (per search digest). Not fetched directly; no independent verification of the results in this run.

items.title: OpenAI and Atlassian expand partnership
items.summary_en: Under the expanded deal, OpenAI frontier models will power agents across Atlassian's platform and Rovo, aiming to turn enterprise knowledge into action.
items.notes: Not fetched directly; date from search digest.

items.title: New visual ad format and measurement tools in ChatGPT
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduced a new visual ad format in ChatGPT. It also expanded measurement tools, attribution partnerships and brand-suitability controls for advertisers.
items.notes: Not fetched directly; date from search digest.

items.title: GPT-Rosalind Academic Plan for research labs
items.summary_en: Eligible academic labs can receive up to 30 Business Standard seats free for up to 12 months. Access to GPT-Rosalind is subject to trusted-access approval.
items.notes: Not fetched directly; date from search digest.

items.title: ChatGPT release notes: GPT-Live-1.1 voice, Slides, GPT-6 Pro speed-ups
items.summary_en: GPT-Live-1.1 and a mini version (Quip) are rolling out in ChatGPT Voice with new voices (Oct 15). On Oct 16, ChatGPT Slides began rolling out to eligible Pro, Business and Enterprise users, and GPT-6 Pro gained faster responses and parallel agents for eligible Pro users.
items.notes: Combines several release-note entries (Oct 15 and Oct 16) in one item. Not fetched directly; exact per-entry dates should be verified.
